name: Josh
bio:
I’ve always been interested in how things work and how things are built. As a kid, I would take apart my toys just out of curiosity to see what was going on inside. I also loved building things, whether it was with Legos, cardboard, or whatever materials I could find. In middle school, I got my first 3D printer, which gave me a whole new way to design and make things myself.

Before I was old enough to get a job, I started picking up free, non-running lawn mowers from Facebook Marketplace, fixing them, and selling them to make some side cash. During high school, my dad got a welder, and I started learning how to fabricate things out of metal, including projects like a custom strut bar. I later became a mechanic at a local shop, where I got more hands-on experience troubleshooting and repairing vehicles.

Since starting college, I’ve also become very familiar with CAD and have enjoyed using it to bring my ideas to life. Now, I’m a mechanical engineering student at Washington State University, continuing to build on the same curiosity and love for designing, building, and figuring out how things work.

hobbies.title: Snowboarding
hobbies.text: There's nothing that hits like being on the mountains on a fresh snowy day. When I'm snowboarding, I feel free. All my worries melt away, and the only thing that matters is how much fun I'm having.
